newsitem.title: USA: RCM Technologies files for 2.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: RCM Technologies files for 2.5 mln shares.

text.p: RCM Technologies Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.5 million common shares.
Of the total amount, 2,323,187 common will be sold by the company and 176,813 common will be offered by selling stockholders. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 7,138,863 common.

The company has offered the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to 375,000 additional common. The offering will be made through Janney Montgomery Scott Inc and Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc.
Net proceeds will be used for repayment of bank debt, working capital and general corporate purposes.
RCM, based in Pennsauken, NJ., is a multi-regional provider of specialty professional staffing services through its 30 branch offices located in 12 states.
